protocol.gate: before every run: no SMHasher process AND one-minute load < 4.5; no timeout
protocol.outlier_rule: absolute deviation >15% from the three-run median, per metric
protocol.units: unaltered SMHasher3 calibrated monotonic-clock cycle estimates on M2; not hardware PMU cycles

load_microbenchmark.units: wall-clock nanoseconds per instruction group; reciprocal throughput, not instruction latency or PMU cycles
